The 2022 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sport S with FOUR-WHEEL DRIVE remains one of the most recognizable and capable SUVs on the planet. Built around Jeep's legendary off-road heritage, it combines open-air freedom, genuine trail capability, modern technology, and everyday practicality into a package unlike anything else on the road. Its four-wheel-drive system enhances confidence during rain, snow, and changing conditions, while removable doors and roof panels provide an ownership experience that few competitors can match. In true Jeep fashion, it is engineered to Go Anywhere, Do Anything. The Wrangler's greatest advantage is that it remains purpose-built for adventure. While SUVs such as the Ford Bronco, Toyota 4Runner, and Land Rover Defender offer impressive capability, the Wrangler continues to stand apart through its removable roof and doors, solid-axle design, aftermarket support, and decades of proven trail credibility. Few vehicles offer such a unique combination of daily usability and off-road authenticity. Many reviewers sat down intending to evaluate the Wrangler objectively ... but ended up sounding like they were planning their next trail expedition. Named to multiple Car and Driver Editors' Choice lists. Consistently recognized as one of the most capable off-road vehicles available. Praised by Edmunds for its unmatched open-air driving experience. Commended for its exceptional aftermarket support and customization potential. Widely regarded as the benchmark against which many off-road SUVs are measured. Frequently recommended by automotive publications for buyers seeking authentic adventure capability. The 2022 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sport S comes standard with four-wheel drive, skid plates, tow hooks, removable roof and doors, fog lamps, electronic stability control, traction control, push-button start, rearview camera, Bluetooth connectivity, and a variety of driver-information and convenience features designed to support both everyday driving and off-road adventures. The heart of this Wrangler is its turbocharged 2.0-liter direct-injected four-cylinder engine producing 270 horsepower and 295 lb-ft of torque. Those figures provide impressive low-end response and strong acceleration while helping improve efficiency compared to larger naturally aspirated engines. The advanced engine is paired with Jeep's excellent eight-speed automatic transmission, which delivers smooth shifts, responsive performance, and well-spaced gearing for both highway cruising and trail work. Four-wheel drive, a durable Dana rear axle, and Selec-Speed Control further enhance capability when the pavement ends. The result is a Wrangler that feels equally comfortable crawling over obstacles, exploring remote trails, or commuting to work. The Wrangler's exterior remains unmistakably iconic. Signature round headlamps, the legendary seven-slot grille, removable body components, and upright proportions instantly identify it as a Jeep. The Black Clearcoat finish highlights its rugged character beautifully, while the factory alloy wheels and available Gorilla Glass windshield help balance durability and style. Every angle reinforces the Wrangler's reputation as a purpose-built adventure vehicle. Inside, the cabin successfully blends rugged functionality with modern comfort. Heated front seats, a heated steering wheel, automatic climate control, premium cloth seating surfaces, and the leather-wrapped steering wheel create a welcoming environment regardless of weather conditions. The four-door Unlimited configuration adds excellent rear-seat accessibility and cargo flexibility, making it substantially more practical than earlier two-door Wranglers. One of the Defender's greatest advantages is its ability to combine genuine off-road capability with luxury-SUV refinement. While competitors such as the Jeep Wrangler Unlimited, Mercedes-Benz G-Class, Toyota Land Cruiser, and Lexus GX each excel in specific areas, few deliver the Defender's unique blend of modern engineering, premium comfort, sophisticated road manners, and trail-ready capability. If Land Rover's mission was to create a vehicle capable of crossing continents in comfort while tackling terrain that would stop lesser SUVs, the Defender understood the assignment perfectly. The Defender's defining mechanical strength is its ability to blend luxury-SUV refinement with genuine all-terrain capability. This SE model is powered by Land Rover's turbocharged and supercharged 3.0-liter inline-six engine paired with a 48-volt mild-hybrid system producing 395 horsepower. Unlike a traditional hybrid, NO PLUGGING IN NECESSARY! The integrated electric motor-generator helps smooth the automatic stop/start system, recaptures energy during braking and deceleration, assists the gasoline engine during acceleration, and improves overall efficiency and responsiveness. Power is routed through a sophisticated eight-speed automatic transmission whose broad ratio spread helps balance strong acceleration with relaxed highway cruising. Permanent all-wheel drive continuously manages traction at all four wheels, while Terrain Response technology optimizes vehicle settings for changing surfaces and conditions. The result is a luxury SUV that feels effortless on the highway, remarkably composed around town, and exceptionally capable when the pavement ends. The exterior design successfully modernizes one of the most iconic SUVs ever built. Its upright profile, short overhangs, signature alpine roof styling cues, and distinctive LED lighting create an unmistakable presence. The Santorini Black Metallic finish complements the Defender's bold proportions beautifully, while the opening panoramic sunroof adds both visual appeal and functionality. The design manages to feel contemporary without abandoning the rugged character that made the original Defender famous. Inside, the cabin blends durability with luxury. The Premium Upgrade Interior Pack transforms the environment with extensive leather appointments, heated and cooled memory seating, premium materials, and elegant Rough Cut Walnut veneer trim. Three-zone climate control helps keep passengers comfortable throughout the cabin, while the available third-row seating increases versatility. Cabin Air Ionization and the Air Quality Sensor further contribute to a more pleasant driving environment. The result is a cabin that feels equally appropriate for a mountain expedition or an upscale evening out. Technology is another area where the Defender excels. The infotainment system integrates navigation, smartphone connectivity, media controls, and vehicle functions through a modern touchscreen interface. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto help seamlessly integrate compatible devices, while SiriusXM and connected features may require subscription. The digital displays are intuitive and attractive, helping drivers stay informed without unnecessary complexity. Safety and driver-assistance technologies help complement the Defender's adventurous character. Features include Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop and Go, automatic emergency braking, lane-keeping assistance, blind-spot monitoring, parking sensors, traction control, stability control, hill-descent control, multiple airbags, and advanced electronic systems designed to improve confidence in a wide range of driving conditions. The 2022 Ford Bronco Sport with FOUR-WHEEL DRIVE delivers much of the adventurous spirit that made the Bronco name legendary while packaging it into a practical, efficient, and easy-to-live-with compact SUV. The Bronco Sport's primary strength is its balance of efficiency, capability, and everyday usability. Standard models are powered by Ford's turbocharged 1.5-liter EcoBoost three-cylinder engine producing 181 horsepower and paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission. The transmission delivers smooth operation while helping maximize fuel economy and responsiveness. The advanced four-wheel-drive system continuously monitors conditions and automatically adjusts power distribution when additional traction is needed. Combined with Ford's terrain-management technology, the result is a vehicle that feels composed during daily commuting yet remains prepared for weekend adventures. The exterior design is unmistakably Bronco-inspired. Its upright stance, short overhangs, bold grille treatment, and rugged styling cues help distinguish it from more conventional compact SUVs. Functional design elements contribute to both appearance and usability, while the elevated ride height provides a commanding driving position. The overall look successfully captures the spirit of larger Bronco models in a more city-friendly package. Inside, the cabin emphasizes practicality without sacrificing comfort. The thoughtfully designed interior offers excellent visibility, durable materials, and smart storage solutions throughout. Supportive seating, versatile rear-seat configurations, and a highly functional cargo area help make the Bronco Sport an excellent companion for everything from daily errands to weekend getaways. The available Cargo Management System further enhances its already impressive utility. Technology is straightforward and user-friendly. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto help seamlessly connect compatible devices, while connected services may require subscription. Multiple USB ports and intuitive controls help ensure convenience for both drivers and passengers. Safety was a major focus during development. Advanced driver-assistance technologies include automatic emergency braking, lane-keeping assistance, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, automatic high beams, traction control, stability control, and a full complement of airbags.
